scope: exploratory same-resolution four-video leave-one-video-out architecture probe
graph: observed t0 query UV, symmetric 2D kNN k=3; all 48 query nodes; no future-validity pruning
global_object_state: mean of 48 query embeddings at each future prediction slot
temporal_receptive_field: 3 predicted slots via shared Conv1d, no future labels
loss: 0.5 centered point MSE + 0.5 valid-edge-vector MSE; no rigid-length restriction
baseline: frozen MotionForesight P0; no trainable scalar gate; zero-initialized decoder output
exploratory_signal: joint_relational improves both primary metrics against P0 and joint_node_control on at least 3 of 4 held-out videos by five-seed medians; raw ADE does not rise more than 5% on those videos
known_limits: all four videos already studied in prior F2 experiments; not independent confirmatory evaluation
TrackCraft3R future displacement is pseudo-GT rather than true motion
MotionForesight backbone frozen; this does not test a trainable generation-time adapter
only four independent videos; five initialization seeds do not increase independent video count
